subtopic: Guaranteed Minimum Income and Accumulation Benefits
source_evidence: Guaranteed minimum income benefits. These benefits provide a minimum value you can turn into a stream of income payments, regardless of market performance. Guaranteed minimum accumulation benefits. These benefits provide that your contract value will be at least equal to a stated minimum amount after a specified number of years, regardless of market performance.
answer: Guaranteed minimum income and accumulation benefits are optional features of some variable annuities. A guaranteed minimum income benefit sets a minimum value that can be converted into regular income payments, even if investments perform poorly. A guaranteed minimum accumulation benefit instead promises that the contract value will reach at least a stated minimum after a specified number of years, regardless of market performance. These benefits work differently: one concerns a minimum value for creating income payments, while the other concerns a minimum contract value at a future point. Optional living benefits cost extra and may have restrictions or limitations, so review the contract details and fees.
